summary: Describes using runtime observability to automatically evolve a coding agent's harness over time. Treats the harness as something that can be optimized from traces, not just hand-designed. Connects observability data to self-improvement of the substrate.
title: Agentic Harness Engineering: Observability-Driven Automatic Evolution of Coding-Agent Harnesses
